Name: Adoniram, Officer of Solomon
Summary: Adoniram, son of Abda, was over Solomon's tribute labour, and was later stoned by Israel when Rehoboam sent him to collect it; he is also called Adoram.
KeyStory: Adoniram oversees the tribute and is stoned under Rehoboam.
RelatedPeople: King Solomon; Rehoboam; Abda, Father of Adoniram
LifeLesson: The face of an unpopular policy is often the first to fall.
